name: Medical Information Requests
one_liner: HCP and patient medical inquiries with standard responses, approvals and AE capture.
fits_when: HCPs, pharmacists and patients ask medical questions about your products by portal, phone, email or through MSLs
answers come from an approved standard response library, adapted or written fresh with literature references
custom and adapted answers need medical review before they are sent
inquiries must be answered within a response SLA and tracked to closure
adverse events or product complaints mentioned in an inquiry must reach pharmacovigilance within a day
HCPs sign in to see only their own questions and answers
gives_you: Inquiry intake with triage, priority-based due dates, clarification requests and closure checks
Standard response library with review, approval, versioning and review-due reminders
Responses matched to an approved standard response or drafted custom, with maker-checker medical review
AE capture against the inquiry, forwarded to PV with the minimum criteria and acknowledged with a safety case ID
Inquiry 360 page with responses, adverse events and the full activity trail
Row-level access: HCPs see only their own inquiries and answers

catalogue.description: A medical information desk from question to closure: HCPs and patients ask through a portal, phone, email or their MSL, MI specialists triage each inquiry and answer it from an approved standard response or a custom, referenced reply, a medical reviewer approves custom answers before they go out, and any adverse event mentioned is captured and forwarded to pharmacovigilance. The app is described in the Zango app spec and previewed live as a clickable app with demo data while the requirement is shaped.

compliance: Maker-checker medical review of every custom response
Off-label answers only to unsolicited HCP questions, with balanced referenced content
Adverse events forwarded to pharmacovigilance within one business day
Standard responses reviewed and re-approved at least yearly
Audit trail of every inquiry, response and status change
catalogue.app_prompt_prefill: Medical information desk for our oncology and diabetes portfolio in India. HCPs ask through a portal, the toll-free line, the MI mailbox or their MSL; MI specialists answer from an approved standard response library or draft a custom answer with literature references, and a medical reviewer approves every custom answer before it goes out. Any adverse event or product complaint mentioned is captured and forwarded to pharmacovigilance within one business day, and closed inquiries are synced to our CRM.

changelog: First version: medical information requests on the Zango app spec v1, with inquiry intake, standard response matching, medical review of custom responses and AE capture.
